passage:
The cafeteria started taking photos of leftover food after lunch. The photos were posted near the entrance, showing how much food was wasted each day.
Some students disliked the photos. They said they made the school look bad.
The cafeteria manager explained that the goal was not shame. It was awareness. If students saw how much food was thrown away, they might take only what they could finish.
After two weeks, leftovers became fewer. Students asked for smaller portions or shared unopened fruit with others.
The photos were not pretty, but they were honest.
Sometimes people need to see waste clearly before they believe it is real.
